title: Root-Locus Control of a Two-Mass Spring-Damper System with Disturbance Rejection
expert_review: A challenging multibody control problem illustrating disturbance rejection and root-locus design for higher-order systems.
learning_objectives: Model coupled mechanical systems with disturbances
Design integral controllers for constant disturbance rejection
Apply root-locus methods to high-order systems
Understand stability and oscillation trade-offs in control design
